 Watch Atletico Madrid vs Bayern Munich live in the Champions League 2026/27 with a crunch game at the Metropolitano Stadium today as both sides seek a win to move them closer to the top eight of the table and automatic qualification for the knockout phase.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now in his 15th year as Atléti's boss, Diego Simeone has his side second only to Barcelona domestically, winning their last seven matches in La Liga including a hard-fought 2-1 win in the Madrid derby . Things may be going well in the league for Los Colchoneros – with World Cup winner Álex Baena in fine form, scoring five goals – but they've only managed four points from three games in the UCL. They lost 2-1 at Anfield having taken an early lead, before beating Man United and drawing with Stuttgart. It leaves them 16th in the table, staring down the barrel of the knockout phase playoffs.
 If you're not following the Bundesliga, there are no prizes for guessing Bayern are top of the table. They're unbeaten in eight and scoring for fun with eight goals for Michael Olise and four each for Luis Diaz and recent Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane. Things haven't gone all their way in Europe, however. After thrashing minnows Bodø/Glimt 5-0, they've only managed draws against Arsenal and, in one of the season's biggest shocks, Norway's Viking. After his recent health scare, Vincent Kompany will be hoping for a big performance from his men today.
 Read on as we explain how to watch Atletico Madrid vs Bayern Munich in the Champions League 2026/27 for free.
